literal: Sorrow to us to remain, far away he who went thinking of, fragrant flowers felt ashamed eyes.
translation: Thinking of him who went far away leaving me in sorrow, my eyes have wept so much that they feel ashamed before fragrant flowers.
modern: நமக்குத் துன்பம் மட்டும் எஞ்சி நிற்க, தொலைதூரத்திற்குச் சென்ற காதலரை நினைத்து அழுது என் கண்கள் அழகிழந்து நறுமணமுள்ள மலர்களைக் கண்டு வெட்கப்படுகின்றன.
explanation: The speaker laments the loss of her physical beauty due to the sorrow of separation. Her lover has gone far away, leaving her with nothing but distress. Constantly thinking of him and weeping, her once-beautiful eyes have lost their luster. Now, they feel ashamed to even look at fresh, fragrant flowers, knowing they can no longer match their beauty.
